selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_05:F18 R109 MANAGED Texture2D per-stage mirror readiness aggregation.
summary: R109 adds a bounded non-routing stage-mask aggregate over R108 managed-mirror readiness. It reports required, registered, CPU-shadow-valid, concrete-resource-owned, lifetime-current, expected-device-match, ready and pending masks without exposing an SRV or creating/binding resources. Invalid input fails closed, and hosted proof covers missing registration, foreign-device ownership, external mutation, LockRect recapture, Reset invalidation and post-Reset recovery.

risk_review.reason: The durable regression registry was checked before implementation and contained no protected risk path matching the bounded src/vr/d3d11/native_backend.* change. R109 does not modify D3D9 CreateDevice/Reset/Present activation, DirectGPU transport, R30 renderer ownership or selector flow. Runtime/HMD correctness is not inferred from hosted CI.

backend_conversion_gate.evidence: Queue/baseline/one-click/disassembly/native-transport/source-graph/census checks PASS; Win32 production build PASS; semantic/input-layout/input-signature smoke PASS; input-layout/shader object/linkage probes PASS; R109 constant-buffer probe build and run PASS; binary verification and artifact upload PASS. Hosted log emitted DX11 managed Texture2D stage mirror readiness R109: PASS.

openxr_vr_architecture.evidence: All six jobs PASS: host-x64, game-x86, game-x86-safe-draw-compare, game-x86-r26-hud-safe, game-x86-c1-r29-r28-classify, game-x86-c2-r30-hud.

evidence: Validation-bearing result commit message contains exact controller marker [AUTO:CONVERSION-DX11-00074] and no CI-skip directive.
R109 bounds the stage aggregate to at most 32 stages and fails closed for null key arrays, out-of-range required bits and missing expected devices when any stage is required.

A required stage becomes ready only when its registered R108 shadow is valid, owns concrete mirror device/Texture2D/SRV resources, has current generation/shadow-version lifetime and matches the expected D3D11 device.

Hosted proof verifies a ready required stage, an unregistered required stage remaining pending, foreign-device rejection, external-mutation invalidation, recapture recovery, Reset invalidation and post-Reset recovery.
The source-graph verifier fails if runtime_census.cpp calls R108/R109 observation-only registry mirror APIs.
No N100 clone/worktree, PC fast runner, Quest3/VDXR or in-game execution was used.
resume_cursor: R109 is automation-validated but runtime-untested. Exact per-stage managed-mirror readiness can now be aggregated as fail-closed masks without exposing SRVs or enabling a draw path.
